scene.heading: DMART'S DEBT AGAINST ITS OWN MONEY · 30 SEPT 2026

result.text: 15 PAISE OF DEBT FOR EVERY ₹1 OF ITS OWN

say: Now the scale. On one side, D Mart's debt: its borrowings, plus what it owes on store leases. About four thousand crore rupees. On the other, its own money, the part that belongs to its owners: about twenty seven thousand crore. For every rupee of its own, it has fifteen paise of debt. By that measure, small. But look at the direction.
